final: SELECT AVG(pair_avg_rate) AS mean_pair_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(pair_avg_rate - overall_avg_rate) AS mean_excess_overall_avg FROM (SELECT COALESCE(o.mktnote, '') AS pair_group, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS pair_avg_rate, (SELECT AVG(f2.feerate - f2.rebrate) FROM fees f2 JOIN orders o2 ON o2.recordvault = f2.orderslink) AS overall_avg_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink GROUP BY COALESCE(o.mktnote, '')) WHERE overall_avg_rate IS NOT NULL AND pair_avg_rate > overall_avg_rate
